title: Honeypot with AI agents
summary: Planned final-year project: a honeypot system with AI agents for cyber defense.

title: Linux Shell Interpreter
summary: Functional command-line interpreter written in C. Implements Unix process management, low-level system calls (fork, exec), and PATH resolution.

title: TCP Multi-User Chat
summary: Real-time chat application exploring Python sockets, a multi-threaded server architecture, and a CustomTkinter graphical interface.

title: Custom Unix Shell
summary: Asynchronous terminal shell built in Rust using Tokio for non-blocking I/O. Implements custom command parsing via TryFrom, filesystem built-ins (cd, ls, cat, mkdir), and external process execution.

title: Multi-Threaded TCP Server
summary: Lightweight TCP server built from scratch in Rust. Implements low-level socket handling, HTTP request parsing, and memory-safe buffer management using Rust's ownership model.

title: MNIST Neural Network
summary: Digit recognition neural network implemented from scratch with Python and NumPy, focused on backpropagation and gradient descent without ML frameworks.
